The card also has 18 earlier confirmed fraud cases. Actions taken include automatically creating the case and monitoring connected cards under rule R6, recommending block card under rule R2 (exposure $166.97 <= $2,500 routed L1, pending approval), and recommending filing a report under policy 3a, R6 (routed L2, pending approval).
